nodes.name: Overview — day 38
nodes.positionStyle: visibility: visible; z-index: -97; transform: translate(-768px, 0px); pointer-events: all;

sticky.html:
A delivery delay to a revised ETA video

How it works

Prepare a private revised-ETA asset tied to a confirmed active shipment delay. A private Drive MP4, with full source records retained in Sheets and the n8n ledger, plus asset links, revision, job ID and handoff summary written back to D38Source for delivery support. The workflow reads a source register and related rows, applies its approval and eligibility rules, and creates a concise review video. Fingerprints suppress completed revisions; a Data Table retains accepted jobs and delivery checkpoints. Retries resume polling or delivery. An ambiguous paid response requires reconciliation. Each execution handles one record.

Setup

  1. Install @zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid from Settings → Community nodes before Zvid credentials; a workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
  2. Create Zvid API credentials at https://app.zvid.io/api-keys, Base URL https://api.zvid.io; select them on all Zvid nodes. Connect Google Sheets and Google Drive OAuth2.
  3. In Config, set spreadsheetId, sourceSheet, detailsSheet and driveFolderId. Create the domain columns and delivery headers from the included delivery-delay-video.md guide. Keep source_id unique and increment revision for changed content.
  4. dryRun: false renders and spends credits within maxRenderCredits. True returns an editor draft attempt and quote.
  5. Run manually once, inspect the Drive asset and register update, then enable the hourly trigger. Avoid parallel manual runs. Watch video → Binary → data → View previews completed media.

Zvid setup reference. Support: https://zvid.io/contact
